title: LumiumX creative direction: source of truth for all image generation of one product

illustration_style.description: Medium and illustration approach, e.g. "hand-painted storybook watercolour". Style only: never name a specific subject, character, animal, object, pose, scene or narrative unless the owner's request requires it.

line_weight.description: Outline weight, or "no outlines" for painterly or flat-colour work.

line_quality.description: Character of the linework, or "not applicable" if there are no outlines.

detail_level.description: How much detail and where it is spent. Style only: never name a specific subject, character, animal, object, pose, scene or narrative unless the owner's request requires it.

character_language.description: How characters are rendered IN GENERAL (anatomy, faces, expression, stylisation), or "not applicable". Never which character, what it wears or carries, or its pose.

background_density.description: How busy backgrounds are and how they recede. Style only: never name a specific subject, character, animal, object, pose, scene or narrative unless the owner's request requires it.

composition.description: General composition PRINCIPLES (focal hierarchy, whitespace, text area). Never a particular subject's position, pose or scene; each concept sets its own composition.

palette.description: Palette family and colour relationships. Style only: never name a specific subject, character, animal, object, pose, scene or narrative unless the owner's request requires it.

age_suitability.description: Intended audience, e.g. "adults", "general family audience" or "ages 4-8". Only name an age range for children's products.

print_considerations.description: Practical printing notes for this format (ink coverage, trimming, folding, home-printer limits). Style only: never name a specific subject, character, animal, object, pose, scene or narrative unless the owner's request requires it.

shared_prompt.description: Shared visual-system text added to every image prompt. Style only: medium, texture, linework, palette family, lighting feel, mood, print feel. No specific subject, object, pose or scene unless the owner's request requires it.

scope.description: Set by code: this direction was written under the style-only boundary. Directions without it are legacy and are rebuilt before new concepts.
